text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (We didn't win... Neither Bright nor I<n>placed first...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That was a fine run, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What a shame to have lost! I was so<n>sure I would
be able to win after all<n>that preparation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: M-my apologies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Hic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Sob!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't supposed to lose here... This<n>was the one
race I couldn't afford to<n>lose, and yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm so pathetic! All I've done is make<n>you carry the
weight of our promise<n>all by yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I cannot let things end here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I must accomplish what I set out to<n>do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We must surpass the victories that<n>previous
Mejiro racers like McQueen<n>and Ryan claimed
before us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And forge our own glorious legacies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well... I suppose I must start training<n>anew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Bright seems like a different person.<n>She feels
strong and dignified, just<n>like... Yeah. She's just
like Air<n>Groove.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're so incredible, Bright. What do I<n>have to do in
order to be like y—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober. As you are right now,<n>the future and
glory you crave are far<n>beyond your reach.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because those are things that only<n>one person in
the world can ever<n>claim.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And that person is Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? When...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: When did I start wanting to become<n>someone else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When did I decide that it was enough<n>to claim the
same achievements as<n>someone else?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober doesn't say a word on<n>our way
back from the Kyoto<n>Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's only after we arrive at my office<n>that she
begins to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I finally understand now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I understand what you were trying to<n>say after the
Osaka Hai, and what Air<n>Groove meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I understand what you were trying to<n>say after the
Osaka Hai, and what Air<n>Groove meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know why I can't become like Air<n>Groove, Bright,
or another Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't become someone else. I haveto be me... right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to continue the legacy Ramonu<n>left behind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The reason I decided to race in the<n>Triple Tiara was
because I wanted to<n>be like Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I walk the path she walked and<n>reach the heights
she reached...<n>Maybe if I become like her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And the reason I picked this race<n>schedule for my
senior year was<n>because I wanted to be like Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even today, I was thinking about how<n>great it would
be to be like Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I'm not like them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, Ryan, Bright, Air Groove,<n>and everyone
else...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: They run with their own strength ontheir own path in their own way!They're determined to make themselves shine! That's whatmakes them strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I don't have that confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the resolve to make<n>myself shine! So I
just followed them,<n>hoping to pick up scraps of
their light<n>along the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But doing that won't work. I can't<n>forge a new
Mejiro legacy that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not while I'm so weak!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the fact that you always<n>reassure me.
Really, I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the fact that you always<n>reassure me.
Really, I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I want to confront my problemshead-on. I need to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't keep ignoring the bad stuff. Ihave to admit that I'm a sneakyweakling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But still... You believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But still... You believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You believe that I can overcome my<n>weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You have faith that I'm strong enough<n>to do that...
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I knew you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in the Takarazuka<n>Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not doing it because I want to<n>chase after
Air Groove or because I<n>want to be like someone
else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run in it so I can conquer<n>my
weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm running in it so I can become truly<n>strong.
